title: Solid World Border
description: This mod makes the world border completely opaque. The world border will change color throughout the day to emulate the color of the sky.
body:
A simple mod that replaces the default translucent, blue-striped world border with a solid, opaque surface that attempts to emulate the color of the sky

Good for if you don't want, in a somewhat aesthetically acceptable way, the unaccessible world to be seen
